dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The posterior margin exhibits a deep concave curvature characterized by a jagged spline profile with three primary deep V-shaped notches and multiple secondary irregular indentations.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The morphological apex is classified as rounded with a small pixel radius, showing high-luminance punctate scarring on the distal tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a smooth, convex incline estimated at approximately 30 to 35 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The silhouette displays a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio, with the pixel height from base to apex being approximately 1.5 times the width of the visible fin base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge; numerous small circular white depigmented spots (pitting) scattered across the lateral surface; a distinct dark oval indentation or lesion is visible on the flank below the central dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique 'sawtooth' pattern formed by a sequence of three deep notches concentrated at the posterior base of the fin.
